title: MILO Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg Review: What the Mandaue Race Was Like
seo_title: MILO Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg Review | Mandaue City
meta_description: MILO Marathon 2026 Cebu leg review: 10,000 registered runners at Gatewalk Central, Mandaue, on 6 September, with an Olympian second in the 21K.
dek: The Cebu leg of the 50th National MILO Marathon was run from Gatewalk Central in Mandaue City on 6 September 2026, despite haze fears. Here is what it was like, from the reports on it.
verdict: The Cebu leg is one of the big stops on the National MILO Marathon, which marked its 50th edition in 2026. The Mandaue race on Sunday 6 September drew 10,000 registered runners to Gatewalk Central [1]. It went ahead despite pre-race worries about the haze from Indonesian fires [1]. Jhonn Marc Dizon and Michelle Zamora won the 21 km, with Olympian Mary Joy Tabal second among the women [1]. The series' National Finals follow in Clark in December [1]. If you want a big, competitive Cebu race with a route to a national final, this is it.

sections.heading: The 2026 Cebu Leg
paragraphs: The 50th MILO Marathon's Mandaue leg was run on Sunday 6 September 2026 from Gatewalk Central in Mandaue City, Cebu, and drew 10,000 registered runners [1].
It went ahead despite pre-race concerns about the transboundary haze over Cebu from fires in Kalimantan and Sumatra [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Jhonn Marc Dizon won the men's 21 km, ahead of Janry Pelones and Jerome Casinillo [1]. Michelle Zamora won the women's 21 km, with former multi-time MILO Marathon champion and Olympian Mary Joy Tabal second [1].
The Freeman reported the result the same way: Dizon and Zamora took the Cebu leg [2]. The series' National Finals are held in Clark City, Pampanga, in December [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you are in Cebu and want a big mass race, yes. A field of 10,000 gives it real atmosphere, and the series builds towards a National Final in December.
The longest race at the 2026 Cebu leg was the 21 km, so if you want a full marathon in Cebu, look elsewhere on the calendar.
This review is compiled from published race reports on the 2026 Cebu leg. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
